$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：武曲破軍坐巳亥，《深造講義》p.150。

basis.quote: 须祥其为善于适应，抑或具反拗的本质而定

rules.text: 適應力強：環境順逆，你都能開創；環境不利時，也能利用環境。
rules.en: Strongly adaptable: in good times and bad you can build, and even unfavourable conditions you can turn to use.

source.quote: 即使环境不利，亦能利用环境

rules.text: 反拗的一面較重：順境時不安於現狀，容易妄行妄作去追求過高的理想；逆境時又太重眼前利益，人際關係因此變差。
rules.en: The contrary side is stronger: in good times you won't settle, acting rashly in pursuit of ideals set too high; in hard times you fix on short-term gain, and relationships suffer.

rules.text: 你的武曲破軍與火鈴同宮，這是最嫌的組合：不但性格反拗，客觀形勢也往往逼你反其道而行。
rules.en: Your Wu Qu–Po Jun shares the palace with Huo or Ling, the combination it dislikes most: not only contrary by nature, but often forced by circumstance to go against the grain.

source.quote: 而且客观形势往往逼人反拗

rules.text: 你的武曲化權，星曜性質過份強烈：自己雖能適應環境，卻缺少助力。
rules.en: Your Wu Qu is transformed by Quan, making the stars overly forceful: you can adapt on your own, but lack support.

rules.text: 你的武曲化忌，帶反拗之性。
rules.en: Your Wu Qu is transformed by Ji, which brings a contrary streak.

rules.text: 會照的廉貞化忌，令你帶反拗之性，而且影響最重。
rules.en: Lian Zhen transformed by Ji in your trine brings a contrary streak, and the strongest effect of all.
